title: 二叉搜索树节点最小距离
summary: 给定二叉搜索树，求任意两个不同节点值的最小差值。
insight: BST 中序遍历得到严格递增序列，最小差值一定出现在相邻元素之间，因此遍历时只需保存前一个值。
pitfalls: 必须按中序而非先序遍历
更新差值前确认已有前驱
节点至少两个，结果可初始化为最大整数

solutions.title: 中序相邻差值
solutions.idea: 在有序遍历过程中滚动维护前驱和最小差。
steps: 用当前值减前驱更新 answer，再把当前值设为前驱
递归右子树，结束返回 answer

code.java: class Solution { private Integer previous;private int answer=Integer.MAX_VALUE;public int minDiffInBST(TreeNode root){inorder(root);return answer;}private void inorder(TreeNode node){if(node==null)return;inorder(node.left);if(previous!=null)answer=Math.min(answer,node.val-previous);previous=node.val;inorder(node.right);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private var previous:Int?=null;private var answer=Int.MAX_VALUE;fun minDiffInBST(root:TreeNode?):Int{inorder(root);return answer};private fun inorder(node:TreeNode?){if(node==null)return;inorder(node.left);previous?.let{answer=minOf(answer,node.`val`-it)};previous=node.`val`;inorder(node.right)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { int previous=-1,answer=INT_MAX;void inorder(TreeNode* node){if(!node)return;inorder(node->left);if(previous!=-1)answer=min(answer,node->val-previous);previous=node->val;inorder(node->right);}public:int minDiffInBST(TreeNode* root){inorder(root);return answer;} };
